name: John J. Keeshan
summary: In the Redridge fighting, Corporal John J. Keeshan was taken prisoner by the Blackrock orcs. After the battle around Stonewatch, they dragged him deep into Render's Rock.

sections.title: A Soldier of Redridge
sections.body: Corporal John J. Keeshan serves Stormwind in the Redridge Mountains. He was posted there as Blackrock orcs pressed against Lakeshire and its defenders. When fighting flared around Stonewatch Keep, Keeshan stood with the soldiers holding the line for the kingdom.

sections.title: Captivity at Render's Rock
sections.body: The Blackrock clan pushed north from the Burning Steppes into the Redridge Mountains. Keeshan joined the defenders at Stonewatch Keep, but the orcish assault overwhelmed them. The orcs took him alive and hauled him deep into Render's Rock, where he remained a prisoner behind enemy lines. Alliance rescue parties had to fight their way in to break him out.

faq.answer: Corporal John J. Keeshan serves in Stormwind's army and fought the Blackrock orcs in the Redridge Mountains. He was captured during the battle around Stonewatch Keep and taken to Render's Rock.

faq.q: Why is Keeshan imprisoned in Render's Rock?
faq.answer: The Blackrock orcs overwhelmed Keeshan during the battle around Stonewatch Keep and took him alive. They hauled him to their encampment inside the caves of Render's Rock.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, Keeshan was taken captive while holding the line for Stormwind against the Blackrock orcs in Redridge.
As a warrior, Keeshan shows the danger of the Redridge front, where even hardened soldiers can be overwhelmed and carried off by the Blackrock clan.
